native_ownership_assessment.existing_intent: H4 reap_observed_transport_after_failure(stopped=True) and _acknowledge_independently_stopped_custody already retain the original context to make independent nonproductive observations before release. The latter currently reaches subprocess-producing query, which creates the cancellation gap.
native_ownership_assessment.main_process_resources: Finite parsing/socket work remains in the original retained host process. Zero added child slots is not a claim of zero CPU/RSS or a new free reservation.
native_ownership_assessment.new_design: A direct fixed readonly socket observation in that original same-PID retained context avoids a new child/process group/native-history attachment or post-revocation child grant. This is compatible with the purpose of that existing stopped observer, subject to an explicit reviewed source successor and qualification.
native_ownership_assessment.not_established: There is no public native SDK HTTP-observer API or already-qualified implementation in these pinned sources. This audit does not establish blanket permission to execute after cancellation, confer productive authority, or waive original stopped proof/custody checks.
native_ownership_assessment.release: HTTP absence is only one predicate. Require original native/proc kernel-scope quiescence, actual transport/watchdog reap, original paths gone, same runtime/source identity, all original consumers/finalizers/disposition conditions. Unknown preserves original holds.

original_query_contract.success: Original requires returncode0 and strips bytes; a successor should expose typed fields internally, preserving these exact callers rather than emulate an arbitrary CLI.

proposed_lifetime_and_bounds.cumulative_accounting: Counters/deadlines are on the original retained lifecycle and cannot reset when an observation fails or cancellation occurs. Refuse/pending on any exceeded bound.
proposed_lifetime_and_bounds.daemon_identity: Bound /info ID before/after each absence batch. Refuse on daemon or socket change. Do not accept an unknown-route404; qualify this exact supported endpoint using actual owned present200 then removed404 behavior first.
proposed_lifetime_and_bounds.endpoint: Literal AF_UNIX /var/run/docker.sock only. Never DOCKER_HOST/context/environment/proxy/TCP/SSH, arbitrary URI, method, query string, redirects, auth or credentials.
proposed_lifetime_and_bounds.freezer: No Docker socket request while the actual authenticated freezer scope remains active, including failure paths. Only after its original guard has exited may the original retained observer inspect stopped custody.
proposed_lifetime_and_bounds.json: Strict UTF-8; reject duplicate keys/nonfinite constants/malformed types and excessive depth/field counts; one bounded body, no reusable raw response cache. Parsing/allocation bounds are cooperative, not a kernel memory quota.
proposed_lifetime_and_bounds.same_process: Original _Lifecycle instance, original host PID and thread, actual runner/module/source identities, original actual provider/watchdog refs and retained cleanup context. No receipt/boolean/source hash grants authority.
proposed_lifetime_and_bounds.secrets: Container inspect JSON can contain Config.Env and other sensitive fields. Never return, persist, log, hash into public evidence, or include raw HTTP bodies/headers in exceptions. Keep only ID/name/absent projection and fixed stage/refusal codes; discard bodies promptly.
proposed_lifetime_and_bounds.socket_identity: Capture and later check original resolved socket device/inode/mode and local peer identity; preserve the original /var/run alias rather than inventing a parent-symlink ban. Exact supported identity rules require future host qualification.

required_future_qualification: Verify exact supported local Docker HTTP API semantics without widening methods/paths.

whitelist.acceptance: HTTP200, one strict JSON mapping and string ID matching original lowercase UUID regex; match originally retained daemon ID on later observations. Do not expose the other info fields.

Only a qualified exact-route404 on the same bound daemon counts as absent. HTTP200 is present and must validate returned full Id and bound Name; mismatch, non200/404 or any ambiguity remains pending. Return only a typed present/absent result, or the exact expected public ID when preserving original bytes shape.

Name must come from an actual retained _LegacyDockerContainerLease allocation, not a caller string, with original grok naming profile. Only same-daemon qualified404 is absent. HTTP200 with exact /Name is present even if its Id differs from an earlier fence; a replacement container with that name must block cleanup. Malformed or mismatched responses remain pending.
